summary:
All three cross-file fixes are in place and verified. An earlier interrupted attempt of mine had already written most of this; I checked each diff against the spec, finished the remaining pieces, typechecked both projects and ran the tests.

(1) ONLINE-R6, group orders follow opening hours and menu-section time windows the same way checkout does. Changes are in backend/src/modules/groupOrders/routes.ts, which now imports assertOpenForOrders and assertItemsServedAt from ../storefront/serviceHours.js:
- POST / (start a group) calls assertOpenForOrders(concept, new Date(), false). A closed brand gets 409 BRAND_CLOSED with the "Opens at …" message.
- POST /:code/items calls assertItemsServedAt(go.conceptId, [item.id], new Date()) after the existing check that the item belongs to this brand and is available. An item from another company's brand is still a 404 before any time check runs. An item outside its section's window gets 400 ITEM_UNAVAILABLE.
- POST /:code/submit calls assertOpenForOrders(go.concept, now, false) and assertItemsServedAt(go.conceptId, every line's menuItemId, now). These run after the ban and membership checks and before priceOrder/ingestOrder, so nothing is written when they refuse. go.concept is the full row, so it has id and name.
- Storefront group-order/[code]/page.tsx: submit refetches /storefront/:slug/menu first. If the menu's ordering state says the brand is closed, it stops with that message. If a cart line is no longer on the menu, it stops and names the dishes. Both checks run before the cart is locked, so a refused submit never strands a locked cart. The server's 409 BRAND_CLOSED, 400 ITEM_UNAVAILABLE and the group error codes are shown in their own words in a notice above the cart; adding an item shows the same messages. A cart that is already locked can still be submitted. The page's tax preview now uses concept.taxRateCash, which the GET route already selects, instead of the old concept.taxRate.
- GroupOrderEntryClient.tsx shows the BRAND_CLOSED message when starting a group fails.
- The styling uses only --servd-* tokens and has no emoji.

(2) Tip in the checkout insert (backend/src/modules/storefront/routes.ts): the checkout DTO is now typed as IngestOrderDTO, imported from orders/service.ts. I confirmed ingestOrder accepts tip_cents, writes Order.tipCents in the same insert, and rejects a tip above payment.amountCents. The DTO carries tip_cents: body.tipCents. The tip stays inside payment.amountCents, so the pending payment and the order total are unchanged. The old post-insert update (tipCents plus totalCents increment) is gone. I removed the now-unused OrderDTO import. One narrow case still sets tipCents in the post-insert orderPatch: when the wallet is the payment method and covered part of the tip, so amountCents is below the tip and ingestOrder would reject it (see deviations).

(3) packages/types/src/order.ts: OrderDTO gains an optional, documented tip_cents?: number.
tests:
Tests: 4 files, 79 of 79 passed. groupOrderSubmit.test.ts has 8 tests: the 3 existing submit tests plus 5 new ONLINE-R6 cases.
- Submit at a closed brand gets 409 BRAND_CLOSED; no order is created, and the group stays open with no orderId.
- Starting a group at a closed brand gets 409.
- Adding an item outside its section's window gets 400 ITEM_UNAVAILABLE, and an item whose section is showing still goes in.
- Submit with an item whose section has ended gets 400 and creates no order.
- Company scoping: a second company with a closed brand and an off-window section doesn't affect company A's submit (200), and its item can't be added to A's group (404, nothing written).

Test command:
cd /home/user/servd/backend && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/servd_test_left_build REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379/30 JWT_SECRET=test-secret-for-local-verification-only-not-a-real-key JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=test-refresh-secret-for-local-verification-only NODE_ENV=test npx vitest run tests/groupOrderSubmit.test.ts tests/auditOnlineCheckout.test.ts tests/ordersReconcile.test.ts tests/customersReconcile.test.ts

Typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` exits 0 in both /home/user/servd/backend and /home/user/servd/frontend/storefront. No next build or next dev was run.
deviations:
1) Tip: the fix asked for the post-insert orderPatch.tipCents update to be removed entirely. It is removed for every case except one. When the wallet is the payment method and covered part of the tip, payment.amountCents can be below the tip (as low as 0), and ingestOrder, which I may not edit, would reject that with 422 INVALID_TIP. For that case only, the tip column is still written in the post-insert patch. totalCents is never incremented after insert, so the total and the pending payment are exactly as before in every case. needsOtherFiles item 1 removes this fallback.

2) The tip_cents type lives in packages/types, but the backend actually compiles against its vendored copy, backend/src/_types, which I don't own. So storefront/routes.ts types the DTO as IngestOrderDTO from orders/service.ts rather than OrderDTO (needsOtherFiles item 2).

3) Group-order page: besides refetching the menu and showing the 409/400 messages, I changed the tax preview from the legacy concept.taxRate to taxRateCash, which is the rate the server prices group orders at (CLAUDE.md says never use concept.taxRate). I also let an already-locked group be submitted, because the submit route accepts a locked group.

No schema changes, and no commit, push, stash, checkout or reset.
